name: TrackPositionMarker
meaning: Named positions on the track (start grid forward/backward, others) as a linked list of 0x30-byte records; looked up by (type hash, index).
layout: Payload: 8 filler bytes (0x11) then n records of 0x30; start=(chunk+0x17)&~0xf, n=(size+chunk+8-start)/0x30. Record: +0 next, +4 prev (written at load), +8 u32 type hash (BinHash seed -1, *33+c; 0x8f90f7bf=BackwardStartingPosition), +0xc u32 index, +0x10 f32 x,y,z, +0x20 u16 flags then short ASCII tag (U). 31 files, 8..22 records.
globals: 0x77b190 list head (next), 0x77b194 list tail; nodes linked in place
evidence: 0x441ed0 loop at 0x441f01-0x441f1d inserts each node before sentinel 0x77b190; sub_43feb0(hash) counts and sub_43fef0(hash,n) returns n-th match; 0x422580 hashes 'ForwardStartingPosition'/'BackwardStartingPosition'; bytes of TRACKB1001 record 0 = 8f90f7bf

name: TrackCollisionQuadtree (wmap)
meaning: Quadtree of the collision grid: 8-byte nodes (4 x u16 child); row 0 is the root, leaf value is a wcell row.
layout: start=(chunk+0x17)&~0xf (0..15 filler 0x11 bytes inside size); count=(size+chunk+8-start)>>3; row 8 B.
evidence: 0x441380 (asm 0x44138b-0x4413a4: and 0xfffffff0, shr 3, store [eax],[eax+4], eax=0x77b130 set at 0x441f27); layout detail also in docs/openworld/re_coll.md (repo doc, same binary)

name: TrackCollisionCells (wcell)
meaning: Cell table of the collision grid: f32 x, f32 y, u32 first widx index, u32 count (16 B); row 0 sentinel.
layout: same alignment rule; count=(...)>>4; row 16 B.
evidence: 0x441380 at 0x4413ae-0x4413d0 (shr edx,4; store [eax+8],[eax+0xc])

name: TrackPolygons (wsrc)
meaning: Collision polygons, ground and walls, 32 B each; loader marks every row's runtime body slot (+6) as 0xffff.
layout: pointer = chunk+8 (no alignment); count=size>>5; loader writes u16 0xffff at row+6 for all rows.
evidence: 0x441380 (ghidra: in_EAX[4]=param_1+2; in_EAX[5]=size>>5; loop writes 0xffff at +6, step 0x20); name string 'TrackPolygon%d' pushed at 0x46a440 using ([ebx+4]-[0x77b140])>>5

name: TrackCollisionIndex (widx)

layout: pointer = chunk+8; count=size>>1 (u16 entries).
evidence: 0x441380 (in_EAX[6]=param_1+2; in_EAX[7]=size>>1)

name: TrackWorldBounds
